bonusClawback.title: What a joining bonus is worth if you leave early
bonusClawback.prorated: To pay back, if it's pro-rata
bonusClawback.full: To pay back, if it's in full
bonusClawback.note: Assumes a 12-month clause. An estimate under the new tax regime's 2025-26 slabs, with the bonus taxed on top of the year's salary. Your employer may take the repayment from your final settlement, and the tax on it is easiest to get back within the same financial year.

commuteCost.title: What your commute costs
commuteCost.note: Counts every week of the year as a working week, so take off your leave and holidays for a closer figure. Cost covers a cab or fuel, parking and anything else the trip adds.

ctcTakeHome.title: What a CTC pays you
ctcTakeHome.variableAfterTax: Variable pay after tax, if paid in full
ctcTakeHome.note: An estimate under the new tax regime's 2025-26 slabs, with PF at 12% of basic, gratuity inside the CTC and ₹200 a month of professional tax. It leaves out surcharge above ₹50 lakh, and your employer's salary breakup decides the real figures.

hireCost.title: What your open role costs
hireCost.daysNow: Days it takes you to fill now
hireCost.daysTarget: Days you could get it to
hireCost.perDay: Each day the seat is empty
hireCost.note: A rough floor: each day is valued at the role's salary for that day. It leaves out the candidates you lose while you wait, which usually cost more.

noticeBuyout.title: When your notice ends, and what leaving early costs
noticeBuyout.note: Counts calendar days and a month's pay over 30. Your employer's policy decides the real formula, whether it's basic or gross pay, and whether a buyout is allowed at all.

salaryHike.title: What a hike adds to your payslip
salaryHike.note: An estimate under the new tax regime's 2025-26 slabs, with the same variable share in both CTCs and basic at half of fixed pay. Variable pay is left out of the monthly figures because it isn't paid every month.

offerCompare.title: Two offers, side by side for the first year
offerCompare.yearOne: Offer {{offer}}, in hand in the first year
offerCompare.more: Pays more in the first year
offerCompare.note: Twelve payslips, the variable if it pays out in full and the joining bonus after tax, under the new tax regime's 2025-26 slabs with basic at half of fixed pay. Ask whether the joining bonus has to be paid back if you leave within a year.
